```{r}
#| context: setup
#| echo: false
#| output: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Load combined data
df <- read.csv("combinedratedata.csv", 
               check.names = FALSE, 
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Load separated data
df_separated <- read.csv('separatedratedata.csv', 
               check.names = FALSE, 
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


# Define function to clean columns
clean_currency <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(gsub("[\\$,]", "", as.character(x)))
}

# Clean fields that will be used and drop unnecessary fields
df <- df |>
  mutate(across(
    c(`Minimum Charge`,
      `Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35 Ccf)`,
      `Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    clean_currency
  ))

# select columns
df <- df |> select(-any_of(c("Rates Effective Date", 
                             "Unit",
                             "County",
                             "Water Management District")))




df_separated_water <- df_separated |> 
  select(c('Utility Name',
                  'Water Minimum Charge',
                  'Water Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)',
                  'Water Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)'))

df_separated_water <- df_separated_water |>
  mutate(across(
    c(`Water Minimum Charge`,
      `Water Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)`,
      `Water Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    clean_currency
  ))

df_separated_wastewater <- df_separated |> 
  select(any_of(c('Utility Name',
                  'Wastewater Minimum Charge',
                  'Wastewater Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)',
                  'Wastewater Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)')))


df_separated_wastewater <- df_separated_wastewater |>
  mutate(across(
    c(`Wastewater Minimum Charge`,
      `Wastewater Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)`,
      `Wastewater Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    clean_currency
  ))


# format combined dataset for box plots
df_long <- df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Minimum Charge`, 
             `Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35 Ccf)`, 
             `Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Value))



# format water dataset for box plots
df_long_water <- df_separated_water |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Water Minimum Charge`, 
             `Water Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)`, 
             `Water Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Value))


# format wastewater dataset for box plots
df_long_wastewater <- df_separated_wastewater |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Wastewater Minimum Charge`, 
             `Wastewater Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)`, 
             `Wastewater Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Value))
```

```{r}
#| context: server

# Reusable box plot function
create_rate_boxplot <- function(full_long_df, target_utility, plot_subtitle) {
  req(target_utility)
  n_orgs <- n_distinct(full_long_df$`Utility Name`)
  
  selected_df <- full_long_df |> 
    filter(`Utility Name` == target_utility) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      Percentile = round(mean(full_long_df$Value[full_long_df$Metric == Metric] <= Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
    ) |>
    ungroup()
  
  ggplot(full_long_df, aes(x = Value, y = fct_reorder(Metric, Value, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE))) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "#e3eefd", alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, height = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = selected_df, aes(x = Value, y = fct_reorder(Metric, Value, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE)), 
               color = "#00AA65", size = 3.5, shape = 18) +
    geom_text(data = selected_df, 
              aes(x = Value, y = fct_reorder(Metric, Value, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE), 
                  label = paste0(target_utility, ": $", sprintf("%.2f", Value), " (", Percentile, "%ile)")),
              hjust = -0.15, vjust = -0.5, color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Rate Comparison:", target_utility, " vs. Competitors"),
      subtitle = paste(plot_subtitle, "| (n =", n_orgs, "utilities)"),
      x = "Amount ($)",
      y = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title.position = "plot") +
    expand_limits(x = max(full_long_df$Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.35)
}

# Render plots
output$combined_plot <- renderPlot({
  create_rate_boxplot(df_long, input$selected_utility, "Combined Rates")
})

output$water_plot <- renderPlot({
  create_rate_boxplot(df_long_water, input$selected_utility, "Water-Only Rates")
})

output$wastewater_plot <- renderPlot({
  create_rate_boxplot(df_long_wastewater, input$selected_utility, "Wastewater-Only Rates")
})

# Render dynamic tables

output$combined_table <- DT::renderDT({
  DT::datatable(
    df, 
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = 'caption-side: top; font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; color: #333;', 
      'Combined Rate Data Overview'
    ),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25, 
      scrollX = TRUE,
      initComplete = DT::JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "  $(this.api().table().container()).css('font-size', '12px');",
        "}"
      )
    )
  )
})

output$water_table <- DT::renderDT({
  DT::datatable(
    df_separated_water, 
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = 'caption-side: top; font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; color: #333;', 
      'Water Rate Data Overview'
    ),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25, 
      scrollX = TRUE,
      initComplete = DT::JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "  $(this.api().table().container()).css('font-size', '12px');",
        "}"
      )
    )
  )
})

output$wastewater_table <- DT::renderDT({
  DT::datatable(
    df_separated_wastewater, 
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = 'caption-side: top; font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; color: #333;', 
      'Wastewater Rate Data Overview'
    ),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25, 
      scrollX = TRUE,
      initComplete = DT::JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "  $(this.api().table().container()).css('font-size', '12px');",
        "}"
      )
    )
  )
})
```
